title: Arrest of Trump-linked Operator Reveals Seamy Underworld of Latin American Far Right – Soberanía 120
author: Mexico Solidarity
content:
In episode 120 of Soberanía, hosts José Luis Granados Ceja and Kurt Hackbarth
open with the arrest of Fernando Cerimedo, a far-right political operative
tied to Javier Milei, Rodrigo Paz of Bolivia, and Honduras's Tito Asfura.
Cerimedo was detained in Bolivia after his ex-partner — who was pregnant with
his child — survived an assassination attempt. The hosts explore how this case
exposes the interconnected web of far-right consultants, CIA-linked
operatives, and disinformation networks that have been instrumental in
installing right-wing governments across Latin America.

Next, they examine the U.S. instrumentalization of visa cancellations as a
political weapon, from the revocation of Andrés Manuel López Beltrán's visa to
broader pressure campaigns against left-wing officials across the region. The
hosts contrast this with the worrisome image of Mexico's security chief
smiling alongside DEA head Terry Cole, the same official who has accused the
Mexican government of being aligned with drug cartels.

The episode also covers the ongoing ICE brutality against Mexican migrants,
including the case of José Mejía Hernández, who was brutally beaten and
tasered during a detention in Virginia.

Losers and Haters takes aim at the PAN's pathetic Photoshop of Andrés Manuel
López Beltrán's face onto Nicolás Maduro's body; a transparent attempt to
smear the former president's son while openly advocating for the kind of U.S.
military intervention that has already kidnapped a sitting head of state. The
hosts also call out self-styled "investigative journalist" Peniley Ramírez for
amplifying unsubstantiated rumors without any corroboration, noting that the
Attorney General's Office has already dismissed her claims as false.
